note: Label examples are paraphrased; none is copied from the document being extracted.

documents.title: FEMA flood insurance policy
documents.subtitle: Standard Flood Insurance Policy, Dwelling Form · 44 CFR 61 App. A(1), 2024

schema.defined_term: the name of a term the policy defines, such as 'Covered Auto'
schema.definition: the full meaning given to one defined term, for example 'Any portion of the home located below street level and enclosed on all sides by earth.'
schema.exclusion: a complete clause describing property or loss the policy does not cover, for example 'We do not cover damage to a rental car caused while it is driven on an unpaved road or by an unlisted driver.'
schema.coverage_limit: a dollar amount limit on what the policy pays, for example '$100,000'
schema.time_period: a deadline or length of time, for example 'within 30 days after the accident'
schema.flood_zone: a flood zone designation, for example 'Zone X' or 'Zones B, C'
schema.law_or_agency: a statute, regulation or government agency, for example 'Fair Credit Reporting Act' or 'Department of Labor'

documents.title: Medicare Advance Beneficiary Notice
documents.subtitle: Official form CMS-R-131, filled with synthetic patient data
documents.license: U.S. government form, public domain; all filled-in values are invented

schema.medical_service: a medical test or service the patient may receive, with its billing code in parentheses, for example 'Lipid panel (80061)'
schema.noncoverage_reason: the full reason Medicare may not pay, for example 'Medicare only pays for this screening once every two years.'
schema.estimated_cost: a dollar amount the patient may owe, for example '$120.00'
schema.patient_option: the complete text of one numbered option the patient can choose, for example 'Option 3: I want the scan listed above, and I will pay the clinic for it today. I understand the clinic will not send a claim and that I cannot appeal later.'
schema.provider: the clinic, lab or company giving the notice, for example 'Lakeside Imaging Center'
schema.person_name: the name of the person who signed, for example 'Jordan Lee'
schema.form_identifier: a form number or control number, for example 'Form HHS-690'

documents.title: Scanned hospital lab report
documents.subtitle: Haematology report, photographed page · read with OCR, then extracted
documents.license: Real hospital report shared as a sample; patient details redacted

schema.test_name: the name of a lab test, for example 'Serum creatinine'
schema.result_value: the measured result of one test, for example '1.1'
schema.unit: a unit of measurement, for example 'mg/dL'
schema.reference_range: the normal reference range for a test, for example '0.6 - 1.2'
schema.test_method: the method used for a test, for example 'Method: enzymatic'
schema.section_heading: a section heading in the report, for example 'LIVER FUNCTION TEST'
schema.finding: a written observation about cells or tissue, for example 'mild anisocytosis'
schema.doctor: the doctor who signed the report, with qualification, for example 'Dr. A. Rao, MD Pathologist'
schema.facility: the hospital or lab that issued the report, for example 'Lakeside Diagnostics'
